name: sync-mapping
title: Sync mapping
description: What syncs between two tools: object pairs, direction, how often and what stays manual, in a clear table with the limits listed underneath.
docs: Pass left and right (a name and an optional mark for each tool), rows (your object, theirs, a direction of to-right, to-left or both, a frequency and an optional note) and limits, a plain list of what does not sync. The direction is drawn as an arrow and written out, and a screen reader hears it in full ("Contacts to Customers, two way"). The table scrolls sideways in a region of its own on a narrow block, which can be focused and scrolled with the keyboard, and says so underneath. The first column, your object, stays pinned while it scrolls, so a row never loses its name. The region is a tab stop at every width, also where the table fits: a scroller that cannot be reached by keyboard is worse, and knowing that it overflows takes a script. The block has no state and renders on the server. Words are translated through labels.
